title: Object Storage: cool review — application boundary
content:
Object Storage cool review has the following application boundary. This branch applies only to source charges whose approved tax treatment is US untaxed or verified exempt; a taxable charge remains under the base correction procedure. The accountant completes the pending billing review against its already completed source export in this consultation; set decision incorrect and status approved. No external review is awaited.

Before the corrected cool-storage review is handled, the source-charge shared-capacity entitlement must be completed.

Retain the original approved untaxed tax basis for this corrected review.
